<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Kai bowed towards the leather man. “It has been too long, Chaka. I’d like you to meet my student.”}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|— ''House of Blades'', chapter 6}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Kai Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Kai, also known as Master Kai, is a former member of the [[Dragon Army]] and one of its last loyal soldiers. He was granted one of the twelve keys to [[the House]], which were created by the [[The Wanderer|Wanderer]] for the army's original soldiers. A skilled combatant and instructor, Kai served as a mentor to [[Simon]] and was once the student of [[Valin]]. His hair turned white prematurely due to the influence of [[the House]], and he often conceals his eyes behind shaggy bangs. Kai is characterized by an eccentric and sometimes unpredictable nature, often wandering away from his responsibilities. He possesses a deep affection for small dolls, which he carves from wood and protects fiercely. Despite his reputation as a potentially problematic individual, he was once considered a candidate to become a [[Founder]]. His abilities include the power to manifest a long, gleaming blade named Azura from his fist and the ability to move through space by tearing holes in the world. Throughout his life, he has navigated complex relationships with masters and students alike, eventually facing a confrontation that led to his death.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Kai is a white-haired man with bangs that cover his eyes. He has been seen wearing a white-and-gray [[The mask|mask]] and bears a Shadow{{!}}shadow-written mark of a single chain link on the back of his hand. He is also described as a white-haired swordsman who carries a doll named [[Caela]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Once an eccentric genius with great potential, Kai is now described as a broken wreck who prefers playing with dolls. He has been characterized by the Overlord as having rampant cowardice due to his fear of power, which led him to refuse a deal from the [[Eldest]]. As a master and teacher, he is known for being secretive with his student [[Simon]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Kai serves as the master to his student [[Simon]], with whom he has sparred and shared discussions regarding sacrifices. He is also a teacher to [[Denner Weeks|Denner]] and was once an apprentice to another individual. Additionally, Kai fought [[Indirial]] to defend the honor of the [[The Wanderer|Wanderer]] and has been treated by him as if they were the same person. He also used to hug and stroke the hair of [[Otoku]] and [[Caela]], and [[Lycus]]'s mother warned him never to speak to Kai without another adult present.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|A student of [[Valinhall]], Kai can open a [[Valinhall Gate]] using the [[Dragon's Fang]] and call upon the [[Valinhall armory]] to manifest weapons like a scimitar or a large gleaming hammer. He can manipulate [[stone]] and [[steel]], using [[stone]] to create a shield over his skin or [[steel]]-powered legs to enhance his jumping. Additionally, he possesses the [[Iron|iron]] or black scroll power and can puff into smoke.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Life with the dolls}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|A [[Valinhall Travelers|Valinhall Traveler]] who spends his time talking to dolls, Kai has lived among them for decades.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c8">''City of Light'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c13">''City of Light'', chapter 13</ref> He carries a [[black-haired doll]] and wields both a short [[sword]] and a gold-and-silver blade named [[Mithra]], which he keeps at his belt alongside a [[The mask|mask]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c8" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c14">''City of Light'', chapter 14</ref> Once an eccentric genius who radiated immense potential, the full member of the old [[Dragon Army]] has since become a broken wreck who has not done much in the past two and a half decades.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c14" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c16">''City of Light'', chapter 16</ref> After being crippled by [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]], Kai has retreated to deep rooms and can be found relaxing by [[Valinhall healing pool|Valinhall's healing pool]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c14" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c16" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c17">''City of Light'', chapter 17</ref> He treats [[Valin]] as if he were the same person and is a figure featured in stories told to [[Simon]] by dolls.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c9">''City of Light'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c16" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">18</span></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Transformation into Incarnation}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|After reaching into [[Benson's blue-lit basement|Benson's basement]] to utilize [[steel]], Kai dons a white-and-gray [[The mask|mask]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c22">''City of Light'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c23">''City of Light'', chapter 23</ref> He possesses a power known as the [[Iron|iron]] or black scroll and carries a weapon called [[Dragon's Fang]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c23" /> While wearing nearly complete [[black chains]] around his neck, he is capable of puffing into smoke.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c23" /> As he undergoes a transformation into an [[Incarnation]], his skin begins turning to [[steel]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c23" /> Kai was transformed halfway into an [[Incarnation]], resulting in a bleeding and changed body.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c24">''City of Light'', chapter 24</ref> Following his death, he is memorialized by a headstone in the [[graveyard]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c25">''City of Light'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c28">''City of Light'', chapter 28</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">13</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Kai]] has [[black chains]] around his neck that are nearly complete.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c23" />}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Kai bowed towards the leather man. “It has been too long, Chaka. I’d like you to meet my student.”<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c6" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|“Kai doesn’t tell me anything,” Simon said.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c10" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|“You must be the new, ah, young one of Kai’s.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c18" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|“Where do you wish to be, young dragon?”<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c4" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Talos bowed to Kai. "Master Kai, would you show us how a real member of the Dragon Army fights?<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c18" />}}
